description: This Java class 'ImmutableFunctionExpression' implements the 'FunctionExpression' interface, providing support for various pipeline functions such as filter, default, substring, lower, upper, and delete. It includes methods to retrieve supported function names, check support for a given expression, and resolve expressions into pipeline elements.

classes.name: ImmutableFunctionExpression
classes.description: Immutable implementation of FunctionExpression defining supported PipelineFunctions.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix used for function expressions.

methods.name: getSupportedNames
methods.description: Returns a list of supported function names.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if a given expression name is supported.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a string expression into a PipelineElement, throwing an exception if unsupported.
